attchmntText: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation regarding approval received from National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) for listing and trading of equity shares allotted under Arham Technologies Limited Employees Stock Option Plan, 2024.
voiceSummary: Arham Technologies Limited received National Stock Exchange approval for listing and trading of 4800 equity shares allotted under the Arham Technologies Limited Employees Stock Option Plan 2024. The shares have a face value of Rs. 10 each. Listing and trading commenced on November 25, 2026. The distinctive numbers range from 21812001 to 21816800. No lock-in period applies to these shares. The NSE symbol is ARHAM and the ISIN is INE0L2Y01011. The approval letter reference number is NSE/LIST/2026/58664 dated November 23, 2026.

attchmntText: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Arham Technologies Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call to the National Stock Exchange. The call was held on November 18, 2026. The company reported revenue of INR85.48 crores, an 87% year-on-year increase. Profit after tax rose 53% to INR9.02 crores. Management highlighted strong performance in televisions, fans, and air coolers. Sales are primarily B2B through dealers. The company is expanding into interactive flat panel displays for government and institutional markets. Manufacturing capacity for these displays is fungible with television production. Management guided for an EBITDA margin of 16% to 17% for the full financial year 2027. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Grant of Stock Options under Arham Technologies Limited Employees Stock Option Scheme - 2024.
voiceSummary: Arham Technologies Limited announced on November 21, 2026, that its Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved the grant of 10000 stock options to eligible employees under the Arham Technologies Limited Employees Stock Option Scheme 2024. Each option is convertible into one fully paid-up equity share with a face value of 10 rupees. The exercise price is determined by the committee and must not be less than the face value or more than the closing market price on the previous day. The vesting period starts from the grant date and lasts between one and three years. The exercise period begins upon vesting and expires within three years from the vesting date. The allotted shares are not subject to any lock-in period. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Arham Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
voiceSummary: Arham Technologies Limited board meeting on November 20, 2026, noted the resignation of statutory auditor M/s Badhan and Co effective November 14, 2026. The board recommended appointing M/s Agrawalla Jitesh and Associates as the new statutory auditor. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval at the ensuing Annual General Meeting. The company will file the requisite form with the Registrar of Companies to formalize the appointment.
